|-|Trivia=
*The teaser achievements are part of a quote from a play, ''{{w|Othello}}'', by {{w|William Shakespeare}}, in [http://nfs.sparknotes.com/othello/page_44.html Act 1 Scene 3].
*The achievements for the [[Panic Room (Payday 2)|Panic Room]] heist are the first to have more teasers than released achievements.
*'''A Brush With Death''' is from the original [[Panic Room]]'s [[Achievements#Patch 6|Overkill 145+ achievement]].
*'''The Definition of Safe House is Changing''' is the original Panic Room's poster tagline.
